targets.title: Feeling the future: Experimental evidence for anomalous retroactive influences on cognition and affect.
targets.evidence_quote: To illustrate our proposal we set out to replicate Bem’s experiment in a purely confirmatory fashion.
targets.outcome_quote: It is clear that the evidence in favor of H0 increases as more participants are tested and the number of sessions increases. With the default prior, the data are 16.6 times more likely under H0 than under H1; with the “knowledge-based prior” from Bem, Utts, and Johnson (2011), the data are 6.2 times more likely under H0 than under H1.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The new confirmatory test of Bem’s above-chance erotic-picture detection supports chance performance instead.

reasoning: The methodological agenda includes a completed new-sample confirmatory replication of Bem’s first experiment; references to other psi replications are background.
